title: [Your scenario title]
learningOutcomes: [A judgement the learner should be better at — phrase as an action, e.g. 'decides when to escalate']

variables.label: Example state
variables.description: Delete or replace. Carry state forward with effects and branches.

nodes.title: [Title for opening]
nodes.purpose: Orient and invest: give the learner a role, a context and a stake so the first decision feels like theirs.
nodes.body: [Drop the learner into the situation in second person. Establish role, context and what is at stake.]

nodes.title: [Title for decision-1]
nodes.purpose: A genuine fork mapped to a learning outcome. Each option is a believable mental model, not a right/wrong answer.
nodes.body: [Set up the decision. Make the trade-off real.]

nodes.title: [Title for consequence-1-a]
nodes.purpose: Show, don't grade: reveal what this choice set in motion, specific to the choice.
nodes.body: [Describe the realistic, in-world result of Option 1.]

nodes.title: [Title for consequence-1-b]
nodes.purpose: Show, don't grade: a weaker choice complicates the path but stays recoverable.
nodes.body: [Describe the realistic, in-world result of Option 2.]

nodes.title: [Title for reflection-1]
nodes.purpose: Pull out the principle: lift the learner out of the story to generalise what just happened.
nodes.prompt: [One open question tied to a learning outcome.]

nodes.title: [Title for decision-2]
nodes.purpose: Branch structure: this fork can END after its consequence, RETURN to a shared path, or CARRY a variable forward.
nodes.body: [The next decision. Raise the stakes or narrow the options.]

nodes.title: [Title for consequence-2-b]
nodes.purpose: Route on carried state: send experienced-choice learners somewhere different.

nodes.title: [Title for the strong ending]
nodes.prompt: [What would a different route have changed?]
nodes.debrief: [Tie the outcome back to the learning outcomes.]

nodes.title: [Title for the mixed ending]
nodes.prompt: [What would a different route have changed?]
nodes.debrief: [Tie the outcome back to the learning outcomes.]
